{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 插件：LLM 自动重试设置卡片——重试次数/退避/抖动与 25 个错误码可勾选（也能自己输入），可按 provider/model 单独设策略、回答被输出 token 上限截断时自动续写且提示词可改，内置重试观测面板，改完实时生效。","id":"gh:1337202760","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-llm-retry-settings","slug":"zeng6125-rgb/dsh-llm-retry-settings","topics":["auto-continue","auto-retry","cordis-plugin","deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm-retry","max-tokens"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 插件：LLM 自动重试设置卡片——重试次数/退避/抖动与 25 个错误码可勾选（也能自己输入），可按 provider/model 单独设策略、回答被输出 token 上限截断时自动续写且提示"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"词可改，内置重试观测面板，改完实时生效。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-llm-retry-settings"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`). Tune the retry cou"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nt and backoff from **Settings → General**; changes take effect immediately. Since 0.1.7 it can also"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" **auto-continue a reply that was cut off by the output-token limit**; since 0.1.9 both the extra er"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ror codes and the continuation prompt are yours to write."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Includes the settings UI** (client bundle `lib/client.js`): a card in **Settings → General** — n"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"o separate UI package needed.
- Overrides `maxRetries`, `initialDelayMs`, `maxDelayMs`, and `jitterR"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"atio` on the `agent/request-error` retry policy.
- **New in 0.1.19** — fixes content leaking above t"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"he sticky header: detection now compares the header against the card top, and the cover band is draw"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"n by a pseudo-element. The criterion no longer depends on the host scroll container's padding or nes"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ting depth.
- **New in 0.1.18** — honors the upstream Retry-After hint: waits what the upstream asks"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" (capped by a configurable limit) instead of giving up the retry; 5 more error codes; logs the hint "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"for diagnosis.
- **New in 0.1.17** — fixes saves being rejected after a host upgrade (the write is r"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"e-read and retried once); the card's build tag now follows the package version; save status sits in "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"a fixed slot so a failure no longer shifts the header; unified fonts in the observation panel.
- **N"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ew in 0.1.16** — the card's build tag is now read from `package.json` at runtime (it used to be a ha"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"rdcoded constant that lagged two releases behind); stat tiles are centre-aligned.
- **New in 0.1.15*"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"* — sticky header with save/revert always reachable; the settings card is split into six themed bloc"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ks; the observation panel got a clock column, aligned rows and ratio bars.
- **New in 0.1.14** — dec"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"lares its host requirement (`engines.dsh: >=0.1.6-alpha.1`) so the plugin market can show DSH compat"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ibility. Ships every 0.1.13 fix (0.1.13 never reached npm).
- **New in 0.1.13** — noticeably smoothe"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"r settings-card scrolling: the scroll container now gets a compositing hint (measured p99 30.2ms → 6"},{"id":"p6s18","text":".2–12.1ms; frames over 16.7ms dropped from 11–13/410 to 0–2/410).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Prerequisite: a DSH Desktop profile (the web profile lives at `~/.dsh/profiles/web`)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Option A — GitHub Release package (recommended)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Option B — dsh CLI / pnpm (requires git + network)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The `dsh plugin` command forwards its arguments to `pnpm` in the profile directory:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then enable the plugin in the profile: add `"dsh-llm-retry-settings"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (or u"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"se the Desktop plugin-inventory UI) and restart DSH."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> Note: the command is `dsh plugin` (a subcommand of the `dsh` CLI), not `dsh-plugin`. The `dsh` CLI"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" is bundled with the Desktop app; if it is not on your `PATH`, invoke it via the app's `node_modules"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"` bin, e.g. `node "<app>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" plugin --profile web ...`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Option C — from source"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Link the local build into the profile and register the bundle:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. Open DSH **Settings → General**.
2. Find the **LLM 自动重试** card.
3. Toggle **开启覆盖** (`enabled`) to"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" apply the override.
4. Set `maxRetries` / `initialDelayMs` / `maxDelayMs` / `jitterRatio`, pick ext"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ra **retryable codes** (chips) — or type a code the list does not know into the `自定义` group — and cl"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ick **保存**.
5. Optionally toggle **输出截断自动续写** (`autoContinue`) and set its `maxContinuations` cap — "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"independent of the retry override above. The line it sends can be rewritten in **续写提示词**; leave it e"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"mpty for the built-in wording."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Changes are written to the `dsh-llm-retry` settings namespace and picked up live by the retry engine"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"hanges are written to the `dsh-llm-retry` settings namespace and picked up live by the retry engine."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**A truncated reply did not get continued.** The host half logs every decision it makes to
`~/.dsh/l"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ogs/dsh-llm-retry-settings/host.log` — one line per event, capped at 256 KB. `ctx.logger`
output is "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"not persisted anywhere in desktop builds, so this file is the only way to see what happened.
Read th"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" anywhere in desktop builds, so this file is the only way to see what happened.
Read the last lines:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- no `activate v…` line at boot → the plugin is not loaded (check `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profi"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e v…` line at boot → the plugin is not loaded (check `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The host half registers the `dsh-llm-retry` settings namespace (schema validation + persistence + li"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ve sync) and **prepends** an `agent/request-error` listener that rewrites `retryPolicy` before the o"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"fficial `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` recover runs:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The auto-continue half listens to the session log instead, because a truncated reply is a *successfu"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ntinue half listens to the session log instead, because a truncated reply is a *successful* request:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`turn-stopping` cannot be used for this: its payload carries no end reason, so it cannot tell "the m"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"odel finished" from "the model was cut off".
The continuation is sent as a `plugin`-sourced user mes"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"sage, so the chat renders it as an injected-context row labelled `dsh-llm-retry` rather than
pretend"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ing you typed it. Constructor-seeded events (resume / fork / replay) never reach `session/event`, so"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" reopening an old truncated session does
not trigger a continuation."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Which wording works is provider-dependent: some relays do not echo the previous `reasoning` back on "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"the next request, so the model cannot see where
its thinking stopped and may restart the task. If th"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"at happens, rewrite `continuationPrompt` (e.g. ask it to answer directly without re-thinking) —
send"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ing more "continue" messages cannot fix it."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Host plugin: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
- Client runtime: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-react`
- "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"DSH `settings` service"}],"truncated":true}
